0022600228.text: The Detroit Pistons (7-3, first in the Central and third in the East) head on the road to the Washington Wizards (4-7, 10th in the East), who have lost four straight and sit 2.5 games behind the Southeast leaders. Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The Pistons lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-111 win in Detroit on November 9, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
